notes.title: Big improvements patch 1.2!
notes.notes:
- The game has been optimised, it now performs better on low-end computers.
- The space occupied by the game has been optimized, it used to occupy 28GB and now it occupies 16Gb.
- The object interaction icon has been improved so that it is always visible even if there is a light source.
- Due to some complaints about the handling of the protagonist, it has been improved a lot: The aiming is now more agile, and shoots faster.
- Due to some complaints about the speed of the protagonist, the speed has been improved. In open environments he moves faster.
- A double confirmation has been placed at the time of deleting games, to avoid mistaken deletions.
- Several stability improvements have been made to the levels.

Thank you all for the feedback. My second (smaller and cheaper) game will be published at the end of the month and I'm making a third one for 2025! Thanks to the people who have supported me!

notes.title: Patch 1.1.6
notes.notes:
- Difficulty adjustments have been made.
- Graphics have been optimized for higher performance.
- Space has been optimized, the game now weighs 30gb opposed to the 43gb it weighed before.

notes.title: Patch 1.1.5
notes.notes:
- Now JACK does not take the ammunition if he does not have the corresponding weapon with him to avoid confusion.
- The oil of the Ferris wheel is more visible (change texture). 
- Prevent the last level BOSS to save game for load game and ride Medieval Madness.
- Now you can close the inventory by pressing escape.
- The wall switch of level 4 has been made bigger.
- Now in the mines, the fuse looks better model. 
- Now when Jack dies, the controller doesn't vibrate if the vibration is deactivated.

notes.title: Fas fix patch 1.1.3
notes.notes:
- You can now change the field of view (FOV) from 85 to 115.
- It is now possible to change the resolution scale for those who need more performance.
- It is now possible to raise the FPS limit between several options.
- Small difficulty fix settings

notes.title: Update fixes patch 1.1!
notes.notes:
- Slightly increased character movement speed when running. 
- The spider boss is now easier, and ammo is easier to find.
- It is now easier to cross the spider boss bridge. 
- It is now easier to find the entrance to Frederick's house.

notes.title: Release date UPDATE
notes.notes:
I am very sorry to inform you that due to some small errors that need to be resolved in the console port, the game is delayed two weeks, until April 26.

I apologize again, I hope that these two weeks of margin help so that it can come out as polished as possible.

notes.title: Release date
notes.notes: I can finally announce that the game will be released on April 12 if there are no setbacks. It will be available on Steam and PS5. Thanks for your patience!

notes.title: A small update!
notes.notes:
These last three months have been a little crazy. 

Being on my own, I have had to dedicate myself to polish the game so that it is in the best possible state, without bugs and crashes. There is also the issue of translations and their implementation. There is very little left. Everything will depend on how long it takes us to make the fixes, I hope that by the beginning of 2024 everything will be ready! 

See you soon!
